boards.hardware: ESP32-S3R8, 8 MB octal PSRAM, W25Q128 16 MB flash; 240x240 1.28-inch round GC9A01 SPI LCD; CST816D touch; BQ27220 battery gauge; ES8311 codec and AW8010 amplifier (audio not enabled)
boards.identify: 45.8 x 45.8 x 12.3 mm round touch badge, SW1 hardware power and active-low GPIO0 SW2, 300 mAh battery; pin map supplied by the developer
boards.flash_port: Type-C native ESP32-S3 USB on GPIO19/20; SW2 is BOOT/GPIO0
boards.use: Chinese round-screen badge UI, battery status, ESP-NOW nearby discovery, mutual code confirmation and acknowledged greetings with waveshare-amoled-175-wifi
boards.notes: Profile ojbadge-wifi is currently local-only: NONE denotes no Agent Link platform backend, not absence of the ESP-NOW WiFi radio. Product ojbadge (id 11, enterprise_id 0, esp32-s3) supplied by the developer; platform lookup requires an account token and was not independently verified. No portal, activation, cloud, microphone or speaker. SW2 short press starts friends or greets a connected peer; hold 1 second returns home and stops the radio. Pairing code must be confirmed on both touchscreens. Hardware and cross-board acceptance pending.
